header.description: EQ tab rules (FEAT-EQ): frmMain InvenEquipItem, InvenAddEquip, InvenSetupEquip, InvenClear, cmbEquip_Click, LoadInvenItems, FilterInvenItems, cmdArmNextSlot_Click and the red-box flags CalcCharacterStats sets
notes: The procedures are cut out of frmMain.frm (scenario key frm) and run against the form shim. cmbEquip is a ComboBox array: changing ListIndex raises cmbEquip_Click as in VB6, AddItem appends (the real combos are Sorted, which only reorders the display), Clear leaves nothing selected.

Steps: InvenEquipItem(n, False, unequip), InvenAddEquip, a select step (the user picks the list entry whose ItemData is `item` in cmbEquip(`index`); `as` records whether the entry existed), InvenSetupEquip, LoadInvenItems, FilterInvenItems, InvenClear, CalcCharacterStats (cut at Call RefreshMagic) and cmdArmNextSlot_Click.

Reads: eq = nEquippedItem, prompt = bPromptSave, lists = per slot ListIndex and the ItemData of every list entry (table order), flags = chkEquipHold(0..19).ForeColor (255 is red, 0 is black or untouched).

InvenSetupEquip's ExpandCombo call and InvenClear's call to cmdEquipButtons_Click(514) (manual stat adjustments, not equipment) are blanked; cmdArmNextSlot_Click's filter call and the empty-list test are replaced by a read of frmMain.lblEmpty.Tag (one 0/1 per list index, 1 = the armour filter finds nothing there).
Rows numbered 9001 and up are invented (db_extra); data holds the armour and weapon rows the cases can touch (only the abilities ItemIsUsableByChar reads) and every class row.
